name: Joe Johnson

summary.text: Joe Johnson served as a trustee for the town of Frederick, Colorado, from 2004 to 2008. He later retired from corporate sales and now owns a small business.

experience.text: Retired from corporate sales; currently owns a small business.

education_focus.text: Johnson's priorities center on reducing taxpayer and tuition funding of higher education; he says 'tuition increased 42% faster than inflation' while many degrees have lost value.
On federal research funding, he says it is 'time for our institutions of higher learning to go back to running their own business, and that includes its funding.'
On AI, he says 'AI is among us, and students are already ‘cheating’,' but does not detail a specific policy proposal.
